name: Chinkamo Twins! ~Futago no Imouto-tachi ni Natsukareteru no wa Wakatteta kedo Masaka Ren'ai Kanjou ni Kawaru Nante Omottenakatta Ken~
original_name: ちんかもツインズ！ ～ふたごの妹たちに懐かれてるのはわかってたけどまさか恋愛感情に変わるなんて思ってなかった件～
source:
Uh-oh! My twin sisters are failing their classes!

As a teacher at their school, I feel obligated to help them study, but these two girls have no intention of applying themselves.

I've managed to get them to agree to study sessions in exchange for pampering them, but now they're saying they’ve realized their true feelings for me and are starting to fight over me! What's going on?

Being a big brother to two cute but headstrong girls was already hard enough without adding this to the mix...!

Come explore the depths of forbidden familial love with Chinkamo Twins, a story about two twin sisters who love their Onii-chan a little too much!

[Edited from [url=https://jastusa.com/games/lovelab003/chinkamo-twins!]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
呃-哦！我的双胞胎姐妹的课程不及格！

作为她们学校的老师，我觉得有义务帮助她们学习，但这两个女孩却没有刻意去努力。

我好不容易让他们同意学习，以换取对他们的宠爱，但现在他们却说他们已经意识到了对我的真实感情，并开始为我而战！这是怎么回事？

如果不加上这个，作为两个可爱但任性女孩的哥哥已经够难的了……！

快来与《Chinkamo Twins》一起探索禁忌亲情的深处吧，这是一个关于两个双胞胎姐妹过分爱自己的Onii-chan的故事！
